key_decisions.rationale: Keeps gendered hierarchy and the hoped persuasion of unbelieving husbands.
key_decisions.before: Likewise, wives, be subject to your own husbands, so that even if some do not obey the word, they may be won without a word by the conduct of their wives,
key_decisions.after: In the same way, wives, submit to your own husbands so that even if some disobey the word, they may be won without a word by their wives' conduct
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Likewise, wives, be subject to your own husbands, so that even if some do not obey the word, they may be won without a word by the conduct of their wives,

key_decisions.before: when they see your pure conduct in reverent fear.
key_decisions.after: when they observe your pure conduct marked by reverent fear.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: when they see your pure conduct in reverent fear.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps full status-display list while supplying merely to avoid forbidding clothing itself.
key_decisions.before: Do not let your adorning be external—the braiding of hair and the putting on of gold jewelry or the clothing you wear—
key_decisions.after: Do not let your adornment be merely external—braided hair, wearing gold or putting on fine clothes—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do not let your adorning be external—the braiding of hair and the putting on of gold jewelry or the clothing you wear—

key_decisions.rationale: Retains inner self and divine valuation.
key_decisions.before: but let it be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God’s sight is of great worth.
key_decisions.after: but let it be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable quality of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious before God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but let it be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God’s sight is of great worth.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps women as examples, hope and household submission.
key_decisions.before: For in this way formerly the holy women who hoped in God adorned themselves, being subject to their own husbands,
key_decisions.after: For this is how the holy women who hoped in God once adorned themselves, submitting to their own husbands,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For in this way formerly the holy women who hoped in God adorned themselves, being subject to their own husbands,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains both names, hierarchical address and freedom from intimidation.
key_decisions.before: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. And you have become her children if you do good and do not fear anything that is frightening.
key_decisions.after: as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. You have become her daughters if you do good and do not fear any terror.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. And you have become her children if you do good and do not fear anything that is frightening.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps gendered bodily comparison, equal inheritance and spiritual consequence.
key_decisions.before: Likewise, husbands, live with your wives according to knowledge, showing honor to the woman as the weaker vessel, since they are also co-heirs of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered.
key_decisions.after: Husbands, in the same way, live considerately with your wives, showing honor to the woman as the physically weaker partner and as a coheir of the grace of life, so that your prayers are not hindered.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Likewise, husbands, live with your wives according to knowledge, showing honor to the woman as the weaker vessel, since they are also co-heirs of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps nonretaliation, opposite action and inheritance.
key_decisions.before: not repaying evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, blessing, because to this you were called, so that you may inherit a blessing.
key_decisions.after: Do not repay evil for evil or insult for insult. Instead, bless, because you were called to this so that you may inherit blessing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: not repaying evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, blessing, because to this you were called, so that you may inherit a blessing.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves anthropomorphic eyes, ears and opposed face.
key_decisions.before: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
key_decisions.after: For the Lord's eyes are on the righteous and his ears attend to their prayer, but the Lord's face is against those who do evil.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves real possibility of unjust suffering and quoted command.

key_decisions.after: But even if you should suffer for righteousness, you are blessed. Do not fear what they fear or be troubled,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. Do not fear what they fear, nor be troubled,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps inward consecration and universal readiness.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves manner, conscience and verbal harm.

key_decisions.after: yet do so with gentleness and reverent fear, maintaining a good conscience, so that those who slander your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame for their abuse.
